title: Open transfer of represented Ext cocycles
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism, G an abelian sheaf on the small étale site of X, I an injective resolution of G, J an injective resolution of g*G [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and α:I→g_*J a chain map satisfying I.ι⁰ ≫ α⁰ = unit_G ≫ g_*(J.ι⁰). Let W be an open in X and q a natural number. Let fX:A_W→I^q and fY:A_{g⁻¹W}→J^q be Hom cocycles, where A is the free abelian representable sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map]. Assume their sections under the free-sheaf sections equivalence [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-comparison-data] satisfy sections(fY)=T_W^q(sections(fX)), with T the explicit section transfer [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer]. Then the open-object map of [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map] sends J.extMk(fY) to the pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] of the open-object image of I.extMk(fX). No normalized comparison or homology class is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01F8 and 01FB (cohomology.tex), 03F3 (sites-cohomology.tex), and 0A50; Ext-cocycle expansion of resolution functoriality. Tag pages read online in second reading.

proof.text: Apply resolutionSection_transfer_ext to compute J.extMk(fY) as precomposition of the exact inverse-image Ext class by the explicitly constructed free-open pullback map.

Rewrite by that Ext-class equality and apply etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap_pullback to I.extMk(fX). This separates the resolution comparison from open localization and the identity-generator calculation.

proof_origin.place: W4 second reading: two-step reduction through the represented Ext-class transfer and independent open-object map naturality, with explicit free-open pullback morphism.

theorem resolutionSection_transfer_open_ext
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution G)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G))
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 =
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app G ≫
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (W : X.Opens) (q : ℕ)
    (fX : (etaleOpenFreeSheaf X).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
    (hfX : fX ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (fY : (etaleOpenFreeSheaf Y).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X q)
    (hfY : fY ≫ J.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (hsections : EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv Y.smallEtaleTopology
      (Scheme.Etale.mk (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) (J.cocomplex.X q) fY =
      (openResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α W).f q
        (EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv X.smallEtaleTopology
          (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) (I.cocomplex.X q) fX)) :
    etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)
      q (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (J.extMk fY (q + 1) rfl hfY) =
      openCohomologyPullback g W G q
        (etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap G q W (I.extMk fX (q + 1) rfl hfX))
